header.userPrompt:
Make `Agent.cheapOneShot` robust to cheap models that write a preamble before their answer.

Observed: the branch-naming one-shot (`BranchNamingStrategy.shortenPrompt`) ran haiku in the repo. A project CLAUDE.local.md told it to call an MCP tool first; the call was denied, and the reply was:

    Cannot call agents_md without permission; proceeding.

    implement-issue-196-followups

`Agent.payloadLine` (tools/src/main/scala/orca/agents/Agent.scala) took the first non-empty line, so the branch became `cannot-call-agents-md-without-permission-proceedin`.

Two changes:

1. `payloadLine`: when the reply has no fenced block, use the last non-empty line instead of the first. Keep the fenced-block preference. Check the other `cheapOneShot` callers (e.g. default commit messages) still get the right line, and update the scaladoc and tests.
2. Isolate `cheapOneShot` turns: no tools and no MCP servers (for claude, e.g. an empty `--tools` allowlist and `--strict-mcp-config` with no config). The one-shots only transform the prompt text; they need no repo access. Apply the same restriction on the other backends where their CLI supports it; where it does not, say so in the code.

resultJson.title: Make `Agent.cheapOneShot` robust to preambles and tool denial messages
resultJson.body:
## Summary

Cheap one-shot calls (branch naming, default commit messages) now isolate from tools and MCP servers by running under `ToolSet.NoTools`, and extract the last line instead of the first when no fenced block is present. This prevents permission denial messages and other preambles from being used as the branch name or commit message.

## Problem

Branch naming ran a cheap model one-shot in a project context where CLAUDE.local.md requested MCP tool calls. When the call was denied, the response included a preamble ("Cannot call agents_md without permission; proceeding.") before the actual answer. `Agent.payloadLine` took the first line, producing a branch name like `cannot-call-agents-md-without-permission-proceedin`.

## Changes

- **`Agent.cheapOneShot`** now runs with `ToolSet.NoTools`, removing all tools and MCP servers (the one-shots only transform text, not repo state)
- **`Agent.payloadLine`** uses the last non-empty line as fallback instead of the first, handling cases where models write preambles before their answer
- **All backends** (Claude, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, Pi) now enforce `NoTools` with their best available mechanism
- **Commit message prompt** updated to request "ONLY the message" to discourage preambles
- Updated enforcement table, tests, and system prompt rules to cover the new tier
